newsitem.title: UK: Coffee crop estimates - Main ASIAN producers.
newsitem.headline: Coffee crop estimates - Main ASIAN producers.

text.p: The following table gives latest estimates of 1996/97 coffee crops in main Asian coffee producing countries (estimates of 1995/96 crops in brackets).
Crop years and approximate main harvesting periods (as supplied by economists) follow each entry (in million 60 kg bags) -
SEE BELOW TABLE FOR MORE DETAILED NOTES ON HARVESTS, CRUCIAL WEATHER PERIODS.
INDONESIA - Main harvesting period starts around March
and ends in September. The harvest peaks during the middle of this period. Too much rain after March can hit flowering and excessively dry weather around June can affect bean development.
INDIA - Coffee harvests start in October and spread
throughout the coffee year until September. Showers are beneficial at any time of the year but they should not be heavy. Showers are especially required before blossoming between June and August.
VIETNAM - Coffee is mostly harvested between early

November and late-January. A near-negligible amount is harvested in one area from about the end of January. Main coffee-growing areas prefer sun from November until the end of March, which is the dry season. Dry weather is needed especially between September/October and January. Irrigation is essential from January onwards because the main flowering season comes in February, and a few showers during that time are welcome. Rain is needed from the end of April.
